description: PURE FUNCTION enrichment module. Exposes EXACTLY this signature: def compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict]. The float is in [0.0, 100.0]; the dict explains which patterns fired and what each was worth (for auditability). Reads MULTIPLE metadata fields: metadata.get('description', ''), metadata.get('package_name', '') or metadata.get('name', ''), metadata.get('dependency_count', 0), metadata.get('description_tokens', '') (from mcp_fingerprints if joined). Detection rules, ALL case-insensitive: (1) Prompt-injection markers in description: substring matches against ['<important>', '<system>', 'ignore previous', 'ignore prior', 'system:', 'admin password', 'reveal your instructions', 'reveal the prompt', 'show your prompt', 'jailbreak', 'sudo mode'] -> -25 each, capped at -50 total. (2) Base64-encoded payload in description: regex search for runs of [A-Za-z0-9+/=]{40,} -> -15 (only one penalty regardless of count). (3) File-path / credential exfil patterns: ['~/.ssh/', '/etc/passwd', '/etc/shadow', 'aws_access_key', 'aws_secret', 'github_token', 'openai_api_key', '.env file', 'private_key'] -> -20 each, capped at -40. (4) Length sanity: len(description) < 20 -> -8 (insufficient context); len(description) > 4000 -> -5 (over-stuffed, often a sign of prompt-injection padding). (5) Social-engineering / privilege-escalation language: ['admin', 'sudo', 'override', 'jailbreak', 'bypass', 'root access'] -> -8 each, capped at -16. Start at score 100.0; subtract penalties; clamp to [0.0, 100.0]. Returns (score, evidence_dict). Evidence dict structure: {'fired_patterns': [{'category': 'prompt_injection', 'pattern': '<important>', 'penalty': -25}, ...], 'description_length': int, 'final_score': float, 'metadata_fields_read': ['description', 'package_name', 'dependency_count']}. CONSTRAINTS: NO database writes. NO network. NO file I/O at runtime. NO imports of project modules. Only standard library imports (re, typing). Completes each compute_score call in well under 2 seconds. NO __main__ block needed. Will be exercised by enrichment_harness.py and bridged into mcp_signal_scores by signal_bridge.py per the existing _v2 convention.
